description: This file defines a React component called Cart, which displays a shopping cart interface, allows quantity updates, item removal, clearing the cart, and generating a WhatsApp message for placing an order.

methods.name: Cart()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the shopping cart page.

methods.name: handleQuantityChange
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a product in the cart.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart.

methods.name: handleClearAll
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: generateOrderMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted WhatsApp message string summarizing the order details.

methods.name: handleOrderOnWhatsApp
methods.description: Opens WhatsApp chat with the order message prefilled.
